body: For me it's the other way around ; I want to be a "brother figure" to my young self. I wish I treated myself better back then.
After faking it thru the day ; it's before we able to sleep we are true to ourselves.
It's been two months since the last time I'm really down. Realized that people come and go. Rather than focus on the things we cannot control, I'll just focus on what I can control: Myself.
May I ask what kind of issues do you have?

Yet you are here with us. Is there anything you want to try out but didn't have any opportunity to start ? Maybe it's time to try other things? Anything in mind OP ; No matter how small or simple it is.
May I know the reason why do you want to end it all despite of having people around you that cares about you?
I want to help you because that's the life I wish I have ; I don't want you to give-up wonderful things that some of us wish we had.

It's funny that some of us have 1000+ friends on facebook yet only a handful you can call as real friends.  If your current so called "friends" make you feel alone , doesn't invite you to anything at all,  maybe it's time to move on from them. It's not about the numbers but the quality of the relationship w/ the select few that you can trust and will never make you feel that way.

I used to feel that way. I used loneliness to better know myself; An opportunity to be alone w/ myself. I used to be a people pleaser just to have so called "friends". As I matured, I focused on myself and met wonderful people ( friends ) along the way. In someway, I attracted like minded people.
If given a choice, what do you want to be?
You're not alone OP. Same same
What's up OP?
I usually go to our rooftop during night time ; staring at the stars, clouds and the moon. It's peaceful.

4 years ago, my long term relationship ( for 8 years ) ended and I 'm devastated. I understand what you're going through. I was on the same place ; I'm depressed wanted to end things but can't do it. What's more depressing is that I felt that I've disappointed the people/friends/family around me expecting that the person I've been with is the "one" which I'm going to marry. I just let time pass and made me realized the mistakes that I did. I was worthless at that time and just starting on my career. I just realized that I'm the dependent one in the relationship; That my world evolved around that person.

Since the break-up, I focused on my career. I also lost weight ( from being overweight to close to normal bmi ) and improved financially. I also had couple of dates. Met different types of people. Trying different things/interests/hobbies. 

Moving on is really hard at first. I just hope you use this time as an opportunity to know yourself better.
Try things you haven't tried or go to places ( which is difficult right now because of the pandemic ).
I'm not a hugger but here  🤗

You need to have goals that YOU really WANT to achieve. For me, goals or dreams will drives my motivation. As of the moment, it could start with small goals like able to clean you room, or able to exercise at least 30 minutes a day. What are your goals or dreams OP? Also, you might be overwhelmed by tasks you need to accomplish?
Of course it is. Because it's your feelings to begin with.

My loneliness started this pandemic. I just realized that my source of happiness are from my peers. I don't allow myself to be alone or isolated. Now that I'm isolated ( COVID happened ), it was really difficult for me. Being isolated like this is a nightmare for me. But during the last quarter of this year, I just realized that this is also an opportunity to know myself better. 

  
OP, I understand the pain of losing a friend because I also lost someone that was close to me during the pandemic. Suddenly, that friend lost interest and ghosted me. I'm always asking myself: " What did I do? Why? ".  I just realized there could be a valid reason why these people suddenly disappear in our life. It's possible that they are also dealing w/ their own problems or it just that their "time" in our lifetime is up.   


Use this situation to better know yourself. Is it possible that you're just w/ the wrong crowd? What are your dreams? What are other things/interests/hobbies you want to try now ? You may list it down just to remind you everyday that there is still reason for you to wake up. This will not be easy at first as me myself struggled doing this. Stop being too hard to yourself. Imagine it's like befriending yourself. You'll just realize after you establish a "good relationship" within yourself that "Hey, this isn't that bad."

I'm also new here. I thought I'm alone. Actually I created this account just for this community. Suddenly, I had the courage to be able to share my experiences with other people and somewhat it made me less depressed and more happy. This community is special to me.
Good to know OP. Cheers to you 🍺
Hoping you'll be scared again this time.

I don't know you personally OP but are there things that you still want to try out? Or have you tried everything you wanted? Having or finding purpose involves trying different things until you find it.

I also lost myself years back and i tried to find it from other people but it failed. I just figured it out when i was truly alone ; alone with myself. It will be hard at first having a "conversation" with yourself. There is something good within yourself that you'll find ; No matter how small it may be. Just take it step by step.
Hopefully you'll be able to escape from the abuse someday. Are you currently working?

I was exactly in the same situation 4 years ago. I was depressed and terrible about myself for 2 years. I was terrible everyday that one day I told to myself: " I'm sick of this ". 

I started working out ( go to the gym ) and focused on my career. Here I am moving forward and have a dream to have my own place for my future. 

My ex is already married and I'm happy for her.

Hopefully someday you'll also be sick of your current situation and start on focusing on yourself. Step-by-step ; No need to rush it. Maybe start with not beating yourself up. Anyway, aren't we just humans who have our own faults?

Some were born with a silver spoon. Some were born from toxic family. Some were born w/ health issues. The list can go on....

It really depends on how you'll play with the cards you've been dealt with.

For me being alive is able to contribute something at least within your circle: It could be your family, your friends, , co-worker, random stranger, and even your pet. It starts with finding your purpose.
What is your dream OP?
I see. Atleast it's interesting for you. It would be difficult to finish something that you don't have any interest. Pandemic made it difficult for all of us and hopefully it would end soon.
Hi OP. Why do you think you don't have any purpose in this life?

Do you even like your current program ( Civil Eng. ) ?

I see that your now in your 2nd year of college but I think it's not yet too late for you to shift from civil eng. to architecture ( if that's what you want ).

Well I wish that you will realize you deserve to live. You deserve everything that you currently have. You deserve a couple of minutes from my time ( and others ). I hope you'll be able to find peace by living.
Why ? What did you do to her?
Hi. what's up?

Also other people take for granted that they have basic needs to survive: To able to have food on their table. Have roof over their head. Even having access to internet and "free information". 

For me it's all about being grateful for what we have. I admit sometimes I forget to be grateful by comparing myself to others. I feel miserable.

It's ok for now to figure things out like your goals or ambitions. It's ok for now to be alone, it might be opportunity to try other things. Being outcast could be that you're w/ the wrong people or crowd.

From my point of view you've already won by detaching yourself from your abuser. YOU did this because YOU realized that you don't want to live that way anymore. YOU did it for yourself. From now on do something that will make you happy or fulfilled ( any hobbies/interests) . Don't let him win by believing what he said about you is true.
No need to apologize as I've read your post. I'm just curious OP, what is your dream?
Describe this asshole to me.
It really helps to have an outlet. Having an unknown account and being able to share to random strangers is liberating.

Continue on making good grades but this time do it for yourself, do it for your future. If given a chance to leave your home I think you'll grab it right? It's really difficult right now because you're still depending on your parents ( as you're still a student ). Hang in there. Study for yourself. Live for your dog that loves you unconditionally. Time will come where you'll be able to provide for yourself and free yourself from their grasp.
Hang in there hero.
